## If this adds or changes a post

- [ ] Tested on a real machine. `testedOn` has the date, versions and device.
- [ ] `quickAnswer` answers the question in two or three sentences.
- [ ] `WhatBroke` records the errors actually hit, not invented ones.
- [ ] Run through `/humanizer`; no banned filler phrases.
- [ ] Links to its hub and at least two other posts.
- [ ] Two or three inbound links added from older posts (`npm run suggest-links`).
- [ ] Affiliate links disclosed, listed in `affiliates`, and in `_redirects`.
- [ ] Slug unchanged, or a redirect added in this PR.

## Checks

- [ ] `npm run validate`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] Preview URL read once on a phone.
